source.book: 据《史记》卷六十五《孙子吴起列传》改编。
source.excerpt: 起之為將，與士卒最下者同衣食。臥不設席，行不騎乘，親裹贏糧，與士卒分勞苦。卒有病疽者，起為吮之。卒母聞而哭之。人曰：「子卒也，而將軍自吮其疽，何哭為？」母曰：「非然也。往年吳公吮其父，其父戰不旋踵，遂死於敵。吳公今又吮其子，妾不知其死所矣。是以哭之。」

imageReview.originalPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua atlas for《吴起与士卒》. EXACTLY 6 equal landscape illustrations, STRICT TWO columns × 3 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. Target 1024×990. Straight thin cream gutters 6px, no outer margin/header/footer, no merged cells or insets. NO TEXT anywhere: no Chinese, letters, numerals, captions, labels, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermarks. Documents must be blank.
The supplied image is ONLY a STYLE reference: match early Shanghai animation / classic 1950s Chinese small-picture books, expressive stylized ADULT folk-art people with angular eyebrows and noses, larger heads, compact adult bodies, spare fluid BLACK ink lines, FLAT matte indigo/ochre/cinnabar/green blocks, subtle paper grain and warm cream negative space. Simple geometric buildings and restrained landscapes. No realistic skin modeling, brocade detail, modern anime, 3D or glossy shading. Do NOT copy the reference's story, props, characters or lettering.
Character continuity and physical invariants: 吴起成年灰蓝甲短须，普通士卒灰褐衣；伤病部位始终以干净布包住，不画伤口、吸吮接触、血液或医疗操作；母亲年长灰绿衣。父亲战死仅以空盔甲回忆象征。
Illustrate these events EXACTLY in order. The following Chinese describes scenes, NEVER render the text:
1. 吴起为将，与地位最低的士卒穿吃相同。
2. 他不另设卧席，也不骑乘，亲自背粮，与士卒共苦。
3. 有士卒生了疮疽，吴起亲自为他照看处理。
4. 士卒的母亲听说，反而哭起来。
5. 她说，吴起从前也照看过孩子父亲；丈夫后来奋战而死。
6. 如今儿子又受到相同照看，她担心不知儿子将来会死在何处。
